title: Web production: governed prod-specific build path and link correction (Union Eyes -> app.unioneyes.app)
description: nzila-os-web-prod ran the mutable nzila/web:latest, which the staging pipeline overwrites. A cold start of the prod app therefore pulled a staging artifact (staging Union Eyes link, staging URLs); before that it embedded a nonexistent Union Eyes host. This change adds .github/workflows/deploy-web-production.yml: source SHA must be on main, prod-specific build args (NEXT_PUBLIC_UNION_EYES_URL=https://app.unioneyes.app), artifact inspected before push (must contain the prod URL and no retired or staging Union Eyes host), immutable nzila/web:prod-<sha> tag (never latest), digest-pinned deploy through the production environment, health and link proof, automatic rollback to the previous image. First production run replaces latest with the digest-pinned prod artifact. Approver: Aubert Nungisa (anungis437), platform owner, sole platform user, holding service_owner and change_manager; authorized 2026-10-05.
impact_summary: Public marketing/portal web app. One container image swap on nzila-os-web-prod (min replicas 0, single revision). No schema, secret, role or network change. The only user-visible change is the Union Eyes link target (staging container -> app.unioneyes.app).
rollback_plan: The deploy job captures the previous revision and image and, if the post-deploy proof fails, runs az containerapp update back to that image automatically. Manual rollback: az containerapp update --name nzila-os-web-prod --resource-group nzila-canada-prod-rg --image <previous image or digest from the run summary>. Note: for this first release the previous image is the mutable :latest tag (a staging build); every later release is digest-pinned and rolls back to a real prior artifact.

incident_refs: First run 37523571187: post-deploy proof passed on the old revision and auto-rolled back; fixed in #917
post_implementation_review.observations: Second run 37565749040 (source ee2192c72524eafc1a9aeb191e2d062b55b40579) succeeded: nzila/web:prod-ee2192c7... = sha256:d2237c188a8733a36bd0ebafd37f50dff22e055a46f16c7b0ab6174a38321c37, deployed by digest as revision nzila-os-web-prod--0000007. Verified independently: homepage 200, only Union Eyes link is https://app.unioneyes.app, no retired or staging Union Eyes host; app.unioneyes.app/api/ready 200. nzila-os-web-prod no longer references nzila/web:latest. Rollback target for the next release is this digest; the previously verified artifact nzila/web:prod-442eaef2... = sha256:7ad545da... also remains tagged. The first run exposed a proof race (old revision still serving), fixed by requiring a new ready revision. Parity note: ABR, CFO, control-plane and platform-admin URLs still use the same values as gitops-deploy.yml.
